cohort: Fifty mothers and 70 fetuses who underwent minimally invasive fetal surgeries at two tertiary reference centers in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, between 2011 and 2019.
finding: Minimally invasive fetal surgeries were deemed safe for pregnant women, with perinatal mortality and prematurity rates comparable to previous studies, and prematurity identified as the most significant associated problem.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at surgery was 25 weeks; mean gestational age at delivery was 33 weeks.
